<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# ACTION7 reset all collections! Blocks shifted.

print(f"DOWN: board_changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation

        min_r = min(p[0] for p in b)
        max_r = max(p[0] for p in b)

        if min_r < 50:
            print(f"{n['color']} at [{min_r},{min_c}]-[{max_r},{max_c}], px={n['pixels']}")

for r in range(24, 40):
    row = lines[r][10:50]
    if any(c in row for c in 'MRbNwg'):
        print(f"r{r}: {row}")
</parameter>
</function>
